name: cart-crash
description: Cart Crash: ride a shopping cart down an endless hilly town in 3D. Everything you grab piles up in the cart and changes how you steer.

scripts.build:crazygames: node scripts/build.mjs --target=crazygames --out=dist-crazygames && rm -f crazygames/cart-crash-crazygames.zip && cd dist-crazygames && zip -qr ../crazygames/cart-crash-crazygames.zip .
scripts.build:playgama: node scripts/build.mjs --target=playgama --out=dist-playgama && rm -f playgama/cart-crash-playgama.zip && cd dist-playgama && zip -qr ../playgama/cart-crash-playgama.zip .
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --target=crazygames --out=dist-crazygames && node scripts/build.mjs --target=playgama --out=dist-playgama && node e2e/run.mjs
scripts.media: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/media.mjs covers && node scripts/trailer.mjs
